Container.Name: book-translator-hub
Container.Overview: Book Translator Hub is the universal, zero-wait bilingual reading overlay and real-time translation engine for Calibre-Web Automated (CWA), Kavita, and self-hosted ebook libraries. Powered by local LLMs (vLLM, Ollama, Bifrost) or leading cloud providers (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, Groq). Features literary-tuned chunking, instant SSE token streaming, context-aware translation, auto-detect source language, and SQLite WAL persistent caching.
Container.DonateText: Support self-hosted reading tools and translation engine development
Container.Requires: Local LLM (vLLM/Ollama/Bifrost) or Cloud LLM API Key (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Groq)

Config.Name: Appdata (Database & Cache)
Config.Description: Persistent storage for SQLite translations.db and persistent caching

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Direct translation API port (REST + SSE streaming)

Config.Name: Proxy Port
Config.Description: Reader proxy injection port (browse CWA or Kavita through this port to get the translation overlay)

Config.Name: Runtime Role
Config.Description: Runtime role: all (combined API + proxy overlay on :8385 - recommended for Unraid), api (pure API mode for SWAG/master proxy), proxy (reverse proxy overlay), hub (multi-reader)

Config.Name: Calibre-Web (CWA) URL
Config.Description: URL of your Calibre-Web / CWA container (e.g. http://192.168.0.122:8383 or http://calibre-web-automated:8083)

Config.Name: Kavita URL
Config.Description: URL of your Kavita container (e.g. http://192.168.0.122:5547 or http://kavita:5000)

Config.Name: LLM Provider
Config.Description: LLM backend provider: local (vLLM / Ollama / Bifrost), gemini, openai, anthropic, groq, deepseek, openrouter

Config.Name: LLM Model
Config.Description: Model name (e.g. gemma4-12b, qwen2.5-14b, deepseek-chat, gpt-4o-mini)

Config.Name: Local LLM URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint of your local LLM (vLLM/Ollama/Bifrost). Use host IP or host.docker.internal, NOT localhost.

Config.Name: LLM API Key
Config.Description: API key for cloud providers (leave blank when using local LLM)

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated allowed web origins for CORS (e.g. https://books.example.com,https://translate.example.com)

Config.Name: Auth Mode
Config.Description: Authentication: disabled (for private LAN), token (for reverse proxy), cwa_session, reader_session

Config.Name: Allow Insecure Auth
Config.Description: Set to true to allow BT_AUTH_MODE=disabled on private LAN

Config.Name: Batch Size
Config.Description: Paragraphs per LLM call. Higher = faster throughput on GPU models.

Config.Name: Batch Source Budget
Config.Description: Max input source tokens per batch group. Paragraphs exceeding this are split or processed as singletons.

Config.Name: Prefetch Pacing Delay (ms)
Config.Description: Delay in milliseconds between background lookahead prefetch requests (0 to disable pacing)

Config.Name: Max Tokens (single)
Config.Description: Maximum token ceiling for a single paragraph request

Config.Name: Max Tokens (batch)
Config.Description: Maximum token ceiling for a batched request

Config.Name: Max Upstream Inflight
Config.Description: Maximum simultaneous requests sent to LLM backend (e.g. 4-8 for GPU, 1-2 for CPU)

Config.Name: Max Concurrent
Config.Description: Maximum simultaneous batch requests processed by Hub

Config.Name: Request Timeout (s)
Config.Description: Timeout in seconds before an LLM request is aborted

Config.Name: Context Window
Config.Description: Surrounding paragraphs given as [CONTEXT] to LLM for literary coherence

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone
